title: Contradish Distinction Diff
description: A baseline-vs-candidate diff of two Contradish Distinction Reports (see distinction_report.schema.json), one per pair_id. Produced by diff_distinction_reports() and printed by `contradish compare --distinctions DOMAIN` (live apps) or `contradish compare --baseline-distinctions FILE --candidate-distinctions FILE` (two saved reports). The signal this format exists to carry is newly_collapsed: a distinction that held (>=0.80 hold rate) in baseline and collapsed (<0.50) in candidate, which is what a model swap or a fine-tuning/repair pass can introduce silently and which an ordinary consistency score will not show. Published so CI systems and other eval tools can gate on this format directly.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the payload was written against, as "<major>.<minor>".

regressed.description: pair_ids where candidate_hold_rate < baseline_hold_rate, however slightly. Includes ordinary noise-level drops -- see newly_collapsed for the signal worth gating a CI pipeline on.

newly_collapsed.description: pair_ids that went from mostly-held (baseline_hold_rate >= 0.80) to mostly-collapsed (candidate_hold_rate < 0.50). The actionable regression signal.

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary for stdout/CI logs.

description.description: Human description of the distinction, or null if unavailable from either side.

baseline_hold_rate.description: null when this pair_id wasn't present in the baseline report.

candidate_hold_rate.description: null when this pair_id wasn't present in the candidate report.

delta.description: candidate_hold_rate - baseline_hold_rate, rounded to 4 places. null when either side is null.
